annotations.text:
HEXR Companion for Android — current build, recreated from the Kotlin source.

Colours, type sizes, radii and touch targets are lifted from Theme.kt, so what you move here maps back to real values.

The settings area is deliberately clipped — on a 390×844 phone only ~340px is left once the header, the pinned instrument panel and the tabs are placed.

That squeeze is the main thing worth redesigning.
Two levers above each frame: Accent recolours every accent surface at once, and State flips Test between idle and driving, or Quick test between passed / failed / pump.
